XY series · FFI

Furious Fists

Released August 13, 2014 · 114 cards

Expanded

Furious Fists is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the XY series, released in English on August 13, 2014. Its main set has 111 cards, plus 3 secret rares numbered beyond the set (114 in total). It includes 94 Pokémon, 18 Trainer and 2 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).

Illustrators

32 illustrators worked on Furious Fists. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (26), PLANETA (8), Ryo Ueda (7), Toyste Beach (6), Naoki Saito (5), Eske Yoshinob (4), Sanosuke Sakuma (4), Shin Nagasawa (4).
